reviews.body:
### 🔵 Needs a closer look The intentional change of the public v5 ShipmentOptions.Machinable field from bool to *bool can break downstream composite literals, so its release and migration impact requires human confirmation. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes serialization of `ShipmentOptions.Machinable` so callers can explicitly send `false` while preserving omission when unset, addressing USPS rating behavior for non-machinable letters. **Changes:** - Changes `Machinable` from `bool` to `*bool`, enabling distinct unset, `true`, and `false` states. - Adds coverage for JSON, query-string, nested shipment request, and omitted-value serialization. - Introduces a source-incompatible public API change requiring a major-release or migration decision. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | shipment_options.go | Changes `Machinable` to a nullable boolean pointer so explicit `false` values are serialized. | | shipment_options_test.go | Adds tests covering false, true, and unset serialization across JSON, query parameters, and shipment request payloads. |
Review effort: Lite
